A teacher asks students to read a traditional legend about 'Malin Kundang' and a fairy tale about 'Cinderella'. Both texts belong to Narrative Text. What is the primary communicative purpose of these texts?
A. To describe the physical appearance and personality of the main characters in detail
B. To entertain the readers or listeners with a story dealing with problematic events that lead to a crisis
C. To explain the sequential steps on how to solve a real-life family conflict
D. To report factual past events and historical news chronologically to the public
E. To persuade the readers to follow certain rules and moral obligations strictly
examQuestion.options: ["To describe the physical appearance and personality of the main characters in detail","To entertain the readers or listeners with a story dealing with problematic events that lead to a crisis","To explain the sequential steps on how to solve a real-life family conflict","To report factual past events and historical news chronologically to the public","To persuade the readers to follow certain rules and moral obligations strictly"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Rumusan Butir Soal:
Read the following excerpt:
"Years later, Malin Kundang became a wealthy merchant and married a noblewoman. When his ship anchored near his home village, his old mother ran to hug him. Feeling ashamed of her ragged clothes in front of his wife, Malin pushed her away and claimed he did not know her."

Which part of the Narrative Text structure does this excerpt represent?
A. Orientation, because it introduces a new character, the noblewoman
B. Complication, because it shows the rising crisis and problem experienced by the characters
C. Resolution, because Malin Kundang successfully hides his past from his wife
D. Coda, because it shows the behavioral change of Malin Kundang after becoming rich
E. Re-orientation, because it summarizes the journey of Malin Kundang as a merchant
examQuestion.options: ["Orientation, because it introduces a new character, the noblewoman","Complication, because it shows the rising crisis and problem experienced by the characters","Resolution, because Malin Kundang successfully hides his past from his wife","Coda, because it shows the behavioral change of Malin Kundang after becoming rich","Re-orientation, because it summarizes the journey of Malin Kundang as a merchant"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Read the sentence:
"The wicked witch gave the princess two shiny red apples poisoned with a sleeping spell."

In the sentence above, the phrases 'the wicked witch' and 'two shiny red apples' exemplify one of the language features of Narrative Text, namely ....
A. adverbs of time to sequence the events chronologically
B. action verbs in the simple past tense form
C. adjectives that modify nouns to form descriptive noun phrases
D. imperative sentences used to give direct instructions
E. temporal conjunctions that connect two independent clauses
examQuestion.options: ["adverbs of time to sequence the events chronologically","action verbs in the simple past tense form","adjectives that modify nouns to form descriptive noun phrases","imperative sentences used to give direct instructions","temporal conjunctions that connect two independent clauses"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Rumusan Butir Soal:
Read the following excerpt:
"Long time ago, in a peaceful coastal village in West Sumatra, lived a poor widow with her only son, Malin Kundang. They lived happily together despite their poverty."

In the generic structure of Narrative Text, the paragraph above functions as the Orientation because it introduces ....
A. the main conflict between Malin Kundang and his mother
B. the moral lesson that readers can learn from the legend
C. the characters, the time setting, and the place setting of the story
D. the climax where Malin Kundang denies his own mother
E. the final resolution of the economic problem faced by the family
examQuestion.options: ["the main conflict between Malin Kundang and his mother","the moral lesson that readers can learn from the legend","the characters, the time setting, and the place setting of the story","the climax where Malin Kundang denies his own mother","the final resolution of the economic problem faced by the family"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Read the description:
"This iconic white marble mausoleum stands on the southern bank of the Yamuna River in Agra, India. Built by Emperor Shah Jahan, it features a massive central dome, four slender minarets at the corners, and intricate floral carvings on its walls."

What specific place is being described in the text?
A. Namsan Tower
B. Fatahillah Museum
C. Taj Mahal
D. Komodo Island
E. Borobudur Temple
examQuestion.options: ["Namsan Tower","Fatahillah Museum","Taj Mahal","Komodo Island","Borobudur Temple"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Arrange the following sentences into a coherent Narrative Text:
1. Finally, the clever mouse deer tricked the crocodiles into lining up across the river so he could count them and cross safely.
2. One hot afternoon, a clever mouse deer wanted to cross a wide river to reach a field of fresh cucumbers.
3. From that day on, the crocodiles realized that brains could easily defeat strength.
4. However, the river was full of hungry crocodiles waiting to eat him if he swam across.

The correct arrangement based on the generic structure (Orientation – Complication – Resolution – Coda) is ....
A. 2 – 1 – 4 – 3
B. 2 – 4 – 1 – 3
C. 4 – 2 – 1 – 3
D. 2 – 4 – 3 – 1
E. 1 – 2 – 4 – 3

Read the text:
"During the Lantern Festival last night, the entire city square glowed with thousands of red and gold lanterns hanging above the crowd. The air was filled with the joyful sound of traditional drums and the sweet aroma of roasted chestnuts from street stalls."

Why is this paragraph classified as 'Describing an Event'?
A. It gives instructions on how to make red and gold lanterns at home
B. It captures the sensory details—sight, sound, and smell—of the festival's atmosphere so readers feel present
C. It introduces the biography of the festival organizer
D. It explains the chemical process behind burning lanterns
E. It presents a conflict between street vendors and visitors
examQuestion.options: ["It gives instructions on how to make red and gold lanterns at home","It captures the sensory details—sight, sound, and smell—of the festival's atmosphere so readers feel present","It introduces the biography of the festival organizer","It explains the chemical process behind burning lanterns","It presents a conflict between street vendors and visitors"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Narrative Text is one of the genres born from the 'Narration' family, alongside Recount Text, Anecdote Text, Spoof Text, and News Item Text. What distinguishes Narrative Text from a standard Recount Text?
A. Narrative Text uses Simple Present Tense, while Recount Text uses Simple Past Tense
B. Narrative Text always tells factual biographies, while Recount Text tells fairy tales
C. Narrative Text contains a complication (crisis) and a resolution, whereas Recount Text merely retells past events chronologically without a major crisis
D. Narrative Text does not need an Orientation section, whereas Recount Text begins with Orientation
E. Narrative Text aims to inform readers about daily news, while Recount Text aims to amuse readers
examQuestion.options: ["Narrative Text uses Simple Present Tense, while Recount Text uses Simple Past Tense","Narrative Text always tells factual biographies, while Recount Text tells fairy tales","Narrative Text contains a complication (crisis) and a resolution, whereas Recount Text merely retells past events chronologically without a major crisis","Narrative Text does not need an Orientation section, whereas Recount Text begins with Orientation","Narrative Text aims to inform readers about daily news, while Recount Text aims to amuse readers"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Read the sentence:
"Deep in the dark forest, the lost prince wandered alone until he finally found a hidden cottage and lived happily ever after."

Which phrases in the sentence function as adverbial phrases indicating place and manner/state?
A. the lost prince; a hidden cottage
B. wandered alone; finally found
C. deep in the dark forest; happily ever after
D. until he; and lived
E. dark forest; hidden cottage
examQuestion.options: ["the lost prince; a hidden cottage","wandered alone; finally found","deep in the dark forest; happily ever after","until he; and lived","dark forest; hidden cottage"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Why does Narrative Text frequently use specific nouns such as 'the king', 'the queen', 'the stepmother', or 'the magic mirror' instead of general plural nouns?
A. To give general scientific facts about monarchy and objects
B. To refer to particular characters, animals, or specific objects involved in the story
C. To instruct readers on how to make royal accessories
D. To compare different types of rulers in the modern world
E. To avoid using pronouns and adjectives in the Orientation
examQuestion.options: ["To give general scientific facts about monarchy and objects","To refer to particular characters, animals, or specific objects involved in the story","To instruct readers on how to make royal accessories","To compare different types of rulers in the modern world","To avoid using pronouns and adjectives in the Orientation"]

examQuestion.questionText:
In complex Narrative Texts such as novels or long folktales, how does the 'Resolution' section commonly function when a major complication occurs?
A. There can only be strictly one sentence of resolution at the very end
B. There is often more than one resolution to solve the complication, sometimes leading to new minor conflicts before the final ending
C. The resolution always happens before the orientation is introduced
D. The resolution only explains the physical traits of the antagonist
E. The resolution is completely optional and rarely found in narrative stories
examQuestion.options: ["There can only be strictly one sentence of resolution at the very end","There is often more than one resolution to solve the complication, sometimes leading to new minor conflicts before the final ending","The resolution always happens before the orientation is introduced","The resolution only explains the physical traits of the antagonist","The resolution is completely optional and rarely found in narrative stories"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Descriptive Text aims to describe a particular object specifically and factually so that readers can visualize it clearly. Which of the following topics is the MOST appropriate for a Descriptive Text rather than a Report Text?
A. Rhinoceroses in general as an endangered mammal species
B. My favorite black leather shoes that I bought last month
C. How smartphones are manufactured in modern factories
D. The general classification of volcanic mountains in Indonesia
E. The lifecycle of butterflies from egg to adult
examQuestion.options: ["Rhinoceroses in general as an endangered mammal species","My favorite black leather shoes that I bought last month","How smartphones are manufactured in modern factories","The general classification of volcanic mountains in Indonesia","The lifecycle of butterflies from egg to adult"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Consider the following five writing topics:
1. Maudy Ayunda's physical appearance and humble personality
2. The lively atmosphere of the Sekaten traditional festival
3. Komodo Island and its pink sandy beach
4. How a traditional batik cloth is dyed and waxed
5. My cute Persian kitten named Milo

Which topic represents 'Describing an Event'?
A. Topic 1
B. Topic 2
C. Topic 3
D. Topic 4
E. Topic 5
examQuestion.options: ["Topic 1","Topic 2","Topic 3","Topic 4","Topic 5"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Read the short narrative paragraph:
"Yesterday, Cinderella goes to the royal ball in a beautiful carriage. She danced with the prince until midnight. When the clock struck twelve, she runs out of the palace and left her glass slipper."

Which correction makes the text consistent with the language features of Narrative Text?
A. Change 'danced' to 'dances' and 'left' to 'leaves'
B. Change 'goes' to 'went' and 'runs' to 'ran'
C. Change 'struck' to 'strikes' and 'left' to 'leave'
D. Change 'Yesterday' to 'Every day' and 'danced' to 'dance'
E. Change 'beautiful' to 'beautifully' and 'glass' to 'glasses'
examQuestion.options: ["Change 'danced' to 'dances' and 'left' to 'leaves'","Change 'goes' to 'went' and 'runs' to 'ran'","Change 'struck' to 'strikes' and 'left' to 'leave'","Change 'Yesterday' to 'Every day' and 'danced' to 'dance'","Change 'beautiful' to 'beautifully' and 'glass' to 'glasses'"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Read the text:
"Fatahillah Museum is located in the heart of Jakarta's Old Town (Kota Tua). The grand white Dutch colonial building features tall wooden windows, a spacious cobblestone courtyard in front, and historical artifacts displayed neatly inside its rooms. Visitors often take photos in front of its classic facade."

Based on the text, how does the writer help the readers visualize Fatahillah Museum?
A. By explaining the step-by-step ticket purchasing procedure
B. By telling a fictional ghost story that happened in the courtyard
C. By presenting concrete details about its location, color, architectural style, and surroundings
D. By arguing why the government should renovate all old buildings
E. By comparing Fatahillah Museum with the Taj Mahal in India
examQuestion.options: ["By explaining the step-by-step ticket purchasing procedure","By telling a fictional ghost story that happened in the courtyard","By presenting concrete details about its location, color, architectural style, and surroundings","By arguing why the government should renovate all old buildings","By comparing Fatahillah Museum with the Taj Mahal in India"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Students often confuse 'Describing a Process' (a type of Descriptive Text) with 'Procedure Text'. What is the key difference between the two?
A. Describing a Process explains how something works/is completed, why it is done, and what is needed in descriptive paragraphs, whereas Procedure Text gives direct step-by-step imperative commands for the reader to follow
B. Describing a Process always uses Past Tense, whereas Procedure Text uses Future Tense
C. Describing a Process is only for cooking recipes, whereas Procedure Text is only for tourist places
D. Describing a Process uses bullet points with imperative verbs, whereas Procedure Text never uses sequence words
E. There is no difference at all; both have the exact same communicative purpose and structure
examQuestion.options: ["Describing a Process explains how something works/is completed, why it is done, and what is needed in descriptive paragraphs, whereas Procedure Text gives direct step-by-step imperative commands for the reader to follow","Describing a Process always uses Past Tense, whereas Procedure Text uses Future Tense","Describing a Process is only for cooking recipes, whereas Procedure Text is only for tourist places","Describing a Process uses bullet points with imperative verbs, whereas Procedure Text never uses sequence words","There is no difference at all; both have the exact same communicative purpose and structure"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Read the text:
"My smartphone _____ a sleek rectangular body with a 6.5-inch AMOLED screen. Its back cover is matte blue, which _____ smooth and does not easily show fingerprints."

Which pair of words best completes the descriptive text above?
A. had – felt
B. has – feels
C. have – feel
D. is having – feeling
E. will have – will feel
examQuestion.options: ["had – felt","has – feels","have – feel","is having – feeling","will have – will feel"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Read the paragraph:
"(1) My favorite shoes are a pair of classic white canvas sneakers. (2) They have durable rubber soles and clean white shoelaces. (3) First, untie the laces and put them into warm soapy water for ten minutes. (4) Although I have worn them for a year, they are still very comfortable for walking."

Which sentence does NOT fit the characteristics of a Descriptive Text because it shifts into a Procedure Text?
A. Sentence (1)
B. Sentence (2)
C. Sentence (3)
D. Sentence (4)
E. All sentences fit Descriptive Text
examQuestion.options: ["Sentence (1)","Sentence (2)","Sentence (3)","Sentence (4)","All sentences fit Descriptive Text"]

examQuestion.questionText:

examQuestion.options: ["Mengurangi kecepatan dua meter sebelum garis","Mempertahankan kecepatan hingga melewati garis finis; dada dapat dicondongkan ke depan saat tepat di garis","Melompat sebelum garis agar badan lebih cepat sampai","Berhenti tepat di garis tanpa melewatinya","Menoleh ke belakang untuk melihat lawan"]

examQuestion.questionText: Data waktu lari 1.500 meter seorang atlet sekolah: 400 m pertama 1:20, 400 m kedua 1:25, 400 m ketiga 1:31, dan 300 m terakhir 1:12. Pelatih ingin atlet memperbaiki konsistensi. Kesimpulan dan rekomendasi latihan yang paling tepat adalah?
examQuestion.options: ["Kecepatan selalu meningkat sehingga tidak perlu perubahan latihan","Terjadi penurunan tempo pada bagian tengah; latihan pace dan daya tahan aerobik perlu ditingkatkan, dengan simulasi pembagian split","Bagian akhir terlalu cepat sehingga atlet harus berjalan pada 300 m terakhir","Atlet perlu hanya berlatih sprint 30 meter","Data menunjukkan atlet tidak memiliki daya tahan sama sekali"]

examQuestion.questionText: Pengukuran estimasi VO₂max tiga siswa menghasilkan data: Rani 42 ml/kg/menit, Dito 35 ml/kg/menit, dan Sari 39 ml/kg/menit. Ketiganya memiliki usia dan jenis kelamin yang sama. Guru menegaskan bahwa interpretasi akhir harus memakai norma tes yang digunakan. Kesimpulan yang paling tepat berdasarkan data tersebut adalah …
examQuestion.options: ["Dito memiliki kapasitas aerobik tertinggi karena nilainya paling rendah","Rani memiliki estimasi kapasitas aerobik tertinggi di antara ketiganya, tetapi kategori kebugarannya tetap perlu dibandingkan dengan norma yang sesuai","Sari pasti tidak bugar karena nilainya di bawah 40","VO₂max mengukur kekuatan otot maksimal","Ketiga siswa memiliki kapasitas aerobik sama"]

examQuestion.questionText: Guru mengukur denyut nadi istirahat seorang siswa segera setelah siswa berlari cepat 400 meter. Hasilnya 160 kali per menit dan dicatat sebagai denyut nadi istirahat. Kesalahan utama dalam prosedur pengukuran tersebut adalah?
examQuestion.options: ["Menggunakan satuan kali per menit","Pengukuran dilakukan setelah aktivitas sehingga tidak menggambarkan denyut nadi istirahat","Denyut nadi hanya boleh diukur di leher","Denyut nadi istirahat harus selalu 160 kali per menit","Pengukuran denyut nadi tidak berkaitan dengan kebugaran"]

examQuestion.questionText: Program awal siswa adalah jalan cepat 20 menit sebanyak 3 kali seminggu. Setelah dua minggu tanpa keluhan, siswa ingin meningkatkan beban latihan secara aman. Langkah peningkatan beban yang paling tepat adalah?
examQuestion.options: ["Langsung menggandakan durasi dan intensitas dalam satu minggu","Menaikkan salah satu unsur secara bertahap, misalnya durasi beberapa menit, sambil memantau respons tubuh","Berlatih maksimal setiap hari tanpa hari pemulihan","Menghilangkan pemanasan agar waktu latihan lebih panjang","Mengganti seluruh latihan dengan angkat beban berat"]

examQuestion.questionText: Pada tes A, siswa mengangkat beban berat satu kali dengan teknik benar. Pada tes B, siswa melakukan squat tanpa beban sebanyak mungkin selama 60 detik dengan teknik benar. Komponen yang terutama diukur pada tes A dan tes B secara berurutan adalah?
examQuestion.options: ["Daya tahan kardiorespirasi dan fleksibilitas","Kekuatan otot dan daya tahan otot","Kelincahan dan keseimbangan","Kecepatan dan koordinasi","Komposisi tubuh dan power"]

examQuestion.questionText: Seorang siswa berlatih intensitas tinggi setiap hari. Dalam seminggu terakhir performanya menurun, tidur terganggu, otot terus terasa nyeri, dan denyut nadi pagi cenderung lebih tinggi dari biasanya. Keputusan paling tepat dalam mengevaluasi program tersebut adalah?
examQuestion.options: ["Menambah intensitas agar tubuh cepat beradaptasi","Mengurangi beban sementara, memberi pemulihan cukup, mengevaluasi tidur dan asupan, lalu kembali bertahap","Mengabaikan gejala karena nyeri selalu berarti latihan berhasil","Menghentikan minum air selama latihan","Melakukan tes maksimal setiap hari"]

examQuestion.questionText: Ketika melakukan guling depan di atas matras, seorang siswa menumpukan kepala bagian atas ke matras dan leher terasa tertekan. Guru meminta siswa memperbaiki tumpuan sebelum mencoba kembali. Teknik yang benar untuk mengurangi tekanan pada leher adalah?
examQuestion.options: ["Menumpu pada ubun-ubun dan mendorong dengan kaki","Menundukkan kepala, mendekatkan dagu ke dada, menumpu dengan kedua telapak tangan dan bahu/punggung atas","Menumpu pada dahi dengan kaki lurus","Melompat ke depan tanpa bantuan tangan","Membiarkan leher menahan seluruh berat badan"]

examQuestion.questionText: Kelompok siswa menyusun rangkaian senam lantai: sikap awal, guling depan, sikap lilin dengan bantuan, dan sikap akhir. Perpindahan antargerak tampak terburu-buru sehingga keseimbangan hilang. Hal yang perlu diprioritaskan untuk memperbaiki kualitas rangkaian adalah?
examQuestion.options: ["Mempercepat semua gerakan tanpa jeda","Menguasai teknik tiap gerak, mengatur transisi dan keseimbangan, serta menyelaraskan sikap awal dan akhir","Menghilangkan sikap akhir agar rangkaian lebih singkat","Melakukan gerakan sulit tanpa pemanasan","Menambah gerakan salto tanpa penguasaan dasar"]

examQuestion.questionText: Seorang siswa dengan kontrol otot perut yang belum baik mencoba sikap lilin. Ia menopang pinggang dengan tangan, tetapi siku terlalu melebar dan beban tubuh bertumpu pada leher. Tindakan koreksi paling tepat adalah?
examQuestion.options: ["Memindahkan seluruh beban ke kepala agar kaki tegak","Menghentikan percobaan, memperbaiki posisi siku dan dukungan tangan pada pinggang, serta memastikan beban pada bahu bukan leher dengan pengawasan","Memaksa kaki lebih tegak dengan menarik leher","Melakukan gerakan di lantai keras tanpa matras","Meminta teman menekan kaki ke Bawah"]

examQuestion.questionText: Guru merancang pembelajaran gerak berirama selama 25 menit. Siswa akan melakukan gerakan inti dengan tempo sedang hingga cepat dan melibatkan banyak kelompok otot. Urutan kegiatan yang benar untuk menjaga kesiapan dan pemulihan tubuh adalah?
examQuestion.options: ["Inti – pendinginan – pemanasan","Pemanasan – gerak inti – pendinginan","Pendinginan – inti – pemanasan","Inti – pemanasan – pendinginan","Pemanasan – pendinginan – inti"]

examQuestion.questionText: Kelompok melakukan gerak berirama dengan musik 120 ketukan per menit. Sebagian siswa bergerak terlalu cepat dan sebagian tertinggal sehingga pola kelompok tidak serempak. Strategi yang paling tepat untuk memperbaiki keserempakan adalah?
examQuestion.options: ["Mengabaikan ketukan dan bergerak sesuai keinginan","Mengidentifikasi ketukan dasar, berlatih hitungan delapan, dan menyesuaikan tempo gerak dengan musik","Mempercepat gerakan agar semua selesai lebih dulu","Mengurangi amplitudo musik sampai tidak terdengar","Mengubah gerakan setiap ketukan tanpa pola"]

examQuestion.questionText: Tim siswa merancang rangkaian senam lantai untuk demonstrasi. Anggota memiliki kemampuan berbeda: sebagian telah menguasai guling depan dan belakang, sementara lainnya baru menguasai sikap keseimbangan sederhana. Rancangan yang paling inklusif sekaligus aman adalah?
examQuestion.options: ["Mewajibkan semua siswa melakukan gerakan tersulit yang sama","Menyusun rangkaian dengan tingkat kesulitan bertahap, pilihan modifikasi, matras, dan pengawasan sesuai kemampuan","Menghapus pemanasan agar semua mendapat waktu tampil","Meminta siswa pemula meniru gerakan lanjutan tanpa latihan","Melakukan rangkaian di permukaan licin"]

examQuestion.questionText: Setelah gerak inti berirama, denyut nadi siswa masih tinggi dan napas cepat. Seorang siswa langsung duduk dan berhenti total. Prosedur pendinginan yang lebih tepat adalah?
examQuestion.options: ["Berhenti mendadak lalu menahan napas","Mengurangi tempo secara bertahap dengan gerak ringan, dilanjutkan peregangan nyaman dan pengaturan napas","Melakukan sprint tambahan","Minum sebanyak mungkin sekaligus sambil berbaring","Melakukan peregangan balistik dengan hentakan kuat"]

examQuestion.questionText: Ketika latihan kayang, siswa merasa nyeri tajam pada punggung bawah dan tidak mampu menahan posisi. Teman menyarankan agar ia dipaksa bertahan beberapa detik agar lentur. Respons paling tepat dari kelompok adalah?
examQuestion.options: ["Memaksa posisi lebih dalam agar fleksibilitas meningkat","Menghentikan gerakan, tidak memaksakan rentang gerak, melaporkan kepada guru, dan mengevaluasi kesiapan serta teknik","Menekan punggung siswa dari atas","Mengulangi gerakan berkali-kali sampai nyeri hilang","Mengganti dengan gerakan salto"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Diketahui data nilai ulangan matematika dari 20 siswa sebagai berikut:

70, 75, 80, 85, 80, 90, 75, 80, 85, 70, 80, 95, 75, 80, 85, 90, 80, 70, 75, 80.

Modus dari data tersebut adalah ....

Seorang siswa salah mendarat saat bermain basket. Pergelangan kaki terkilir, mulai bengkak, dan terasa nyeri. Tidak tampak luka terbuka. Guru meminta teman-temannya memberi pertolongan awal. Penerapan prinsip RICE yang tepat adalah?
examQuestion.options: ["Rest, Ice, Compression, Elevation: hentikan aktivitas, kompres dingin berlapis kain, balut elastis tidak terlalu ketat, dan tinggikan bagian cedera","Run, Ice, Continue, Exercise: berlari ringan lalu melanjutkan permainan","Rest, Injection, Compression, Exercise: menyuntik obat dan langsung latihan","Rub, Immerse, Cut, Elevate: memijat kuat dan mengoleskan bahan panas","Return, Ice, Carry, End: segera kembali bermain setelah diberi es"]

examQuestion.questionText: Setelah jatuh saat futsal, seorang siswa mengalami nyeri pergelangan kaki sangat berat, bentuk sendi tampak tidak normal, sulit menapak, dan jari kaki terasa kebas. Tindakan pertolongan yang paling tepat adalah?
examQuestion.options: ["Memaksa sendi diluruskan lalu dipijat","Menganggapnya keseleo ringan dan meminta siswa berjalan","Menghentikan aktivitas, menstabilkan bagian cedera pada posisi ditemukan, memantau kondisi, dan segera mencari pertolongan medis","Mengompres panas dan melakukan peregangan kuat","Membalut sangat ketat sampai kebas hilang"]

examQuestion.questionText: Seorang siswa mendapat tekanan dari kelompok pertemanan untuk mengikuti kegiatan yang berisiko, termasuk konsumsi alkohol dan perilaku seksual tanpa tanggung jawab. Ia merasa takut dikucilkan jika menolak. Respons asertif dan sehat yang paling tepat adalah?
examQuestion.options: ["Mengikuti ajakan agar tetap diterima kelompok","Menolak dengan tegas dan sopan, menjelaskan batas pribadi, meninggalkan situasi berisiko, serta mencari dukungan orang tepercaya","Menyetujui dahulu lalu mencoba sekali saja","Menyebarkan identitas teman yang mengajak di media sosial","Menghindari semua teman dan tidak bercerita kepada siapa pun"]

examQuestion.questionText: Seorang peserta didik magang mengonsumsi stimulan tanpa resep agar tetap terjaga saat bekerja. Beberapa jam kemudian ia gelisah, sulit berkonsentrasi, jantung berdebar, dan setelah efeknya menurun ia sangat lelah. Analisis paling tepat mengenai risiko perilaku tersebut adalah?
examQuestion.options: ["Stimulan selalu meningkatkan produktivitas dan aman jika digunakan saat bekerja","NAPZA dapat mengganggu sistem saraf, denyut jantung, penilaian, tidur, dan konsentrasi sehingga meningkatkan risiko kecelakaan serta menurunkan produktivitas","Efek stimulan hanya terjadi pada atlet profesional","Kelelahan setelah efek hilang membuktikan tubuh semakin bugar","Penggunaan tanpa resep tidak berisiko jika dosis kecil"]

examQuestion.questionText: Di lingkungan sekolah beredar tawaran pil yang diklaim dapat meningkatkan stamina saat olahraga. Penjual tidak memiliki izin dan tidak mencantumkan kandungan produk secara jelas. Langkah pencegahan yang paling tepat adalah?
examQuestion.options: ["Mencoba setengah dosis untuk mengetahui efek","Menolak, tidak mengonsumsi zat yang tidak jelas, memeriksa informasi melalui tenaga kesehatan, dan melaporkan tawaran berbahaya kepada pihak sekolah/orang dewasa tepercaya","Mencampur pil dengan minuman energi","Menggunakan hanya sebelum pertandingan","Membagikan pil kepada teman agar efeknya dibandingkan"]

examQuestion.questionText: Seorang pemain mengalami benturan pada paha. Teman menempelkan es langsung ke kulit selama 40 menit dan membalut paha sangat kencang hingga bagian bawah terasa dingin dan kesemutan. Evaluasi tindakan pertolongan yang benar adalah?
examQuestion.options: ["Tindakan sudah tepat karena semakin lama es semakin baik","Es sebaiknya dibungkus kain dan diberikan sekitar 15–20 menit per sesi; balutan harus nyaman dan tidak menyebabkan kebas atau gangguan sirkulasi","Es harus ditempelkan langsung agar cepat dingin","Balutan harus dibuat sekencang mungkin","Kompres dingin tidak boleh digunakan pada cedera akut"]

examQuestion.questionText: Survei kelas menunjukkan sebagian siswa sulit menolak ajakan negatif karena takut kehilangan teman. Siswa yang aktif dalam ekstrakurikuler, memiliki komunikasi terbuka dengan keluarga, dan mengenal layanan konseling cenderung lebih mampu mengambil keputusan aman. Faktor yang paling berperan sebagai pelindung dalam situasi tersebut adalah?
examQuestion.options: ["Tekanan teman sebaya dan rasa takut dikucilkan","Dukungan sosial positif, komunikasi terbuka, kegiatan bermakna, dan akses bantuan tepercaya","Menyimpan masalah sendiri agar tidak diketahui","Mengikuti semua tren kelompok","Menghindari informasi Kesehatan"]

examQuestion.questionText: Ketika pertandingan sekolah berlangsung, seorang pemain terjatuh. Ia sadar dan mengeluh nyeri pada lutut. Di dekatnya ada pemain lain yang mengalami perdarahan cukup banyak dari luka terbuka di lengan. Prioritas pertolongan pertama yang paling tepat adalah?
examQuestion.options: ["Mendahulukan lutut karena cedera terjadi lebih dahulu","Menilai keselamatan lokasi dan kondisi korban, kemudian mengendalikan perdarahan yang mengancam sebelum menangani keluhan lutut","Memberi kompres es kepada keduanya tanpa pemeriksaan","Meminta korban berjalan ke ruang kesehatan","Mengoleskan minyak pada semua luka"]

OSIS mengadakan lomba inovasi pengolahan sampah. Tim A mengetahui rancangan awal tim B dari berkas yang tertinggal. Sebagian anggota mengusulkan menyalin rancangan itu agar peluang menang meningkat.
Sikap yang paling sesuai dengan kandungan QS. Al-Mā’idah/5:48 adalah …
examQuestion.options: ["menyalin rancangan karena semua tim memiliki tujuan yang sama","menyebarkan rancangan tim B agar mereka kehilangan keunggulan","mengembangkan gagasan sendiri dan berlomba menghasilkan karya terbaik yang bermanfaat","meminta panitia menggugurkan tim B tanpa bukti pelanggaran","menghalalkan cara apa pun selama memperoleh juara"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Program kelas bertajuk “Satu Pekan Satu Aksi Baik” memberi pilihan kegiatan: mengajari teman, membersihkan ruang praktik, menyumbangkan buku layak pakai, dan membantu warga.
Makna fastabiqul khairat yang tepat berdasarkan stimulus adalah …
examQuestion.options: ["berlomba memperoleh perhatian sebanyak mungkin","menunggu teman memulai kebaikan terlebih dahulu","aktif dan bersegera melakukan kebaikan tanpa merugikan orang lain","memilih kegiatan yang paling mudah mendapat hadiah","membatasi kebaikan hanya untuk anggota kelompok sendiri"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Seorang peserta lomba kompetensi keahlian menerima pesan anonim yang menawarkan bocoran soal dengan imbalan uang. Ia khawatir kalah jika menolak tawaran tersebut.
Keputusan yang paling mencerminkan fastabiqul khairat adalah …
examQuestion.options: ["membeli bocoran karena peserta lain mungkin juga melakukannya","menerima bocoran tetapi berjanji tidak menyebarkannya","membagikan tawaran itu kepada peserta lain agar persaingan seimbang D . menolak tawaran dan mempersiapkan diri secara jujur","mengundurkan diri tanpa melaporkan indikasi kecurangan"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Dalam diskusi PAI, guru memberi contoh: meyakini Allah, mengucapkan perkataan baik, dan menyingkirkan benda berbahaya dari jalan.
Kesimpulan yang tepat tentang syu’abul iman adalah …
examQuestion.options: ["iman hanya berupa keyakinan di dalam hati","iman hanya dibuktikan melalui ibadah ritual","iman cukup diucapkan tanpa perlu diamalkan","iman memiliki cabang yang mencakup keyakinan, ucapan, dan perbuatan","iman tidak berkaitan dengan perilaku sosial"]

examQuestion.questionText: Kegiatan menjual barang atau jasa untuk mendapatkan keuntungan disebut...
examQuestion.options: ["Olahraga","Kewirausahaan","Rekreasi","Pendidikan","Hiburan"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Di grup kelas beredar tangkapan layar percakapan pribadi seorang siswa. Beberapa anggota membuat meme dan komentar yang merendahkan. Kamu mengetahui percakapan itu bukan untuk konsumsi umum.
Perilaku yang paling sesuai dengan cabang iman menjaga lisan adalah …
examQuestion.options: ["ikut berkomentar agar tidak dianggap kaku","menghentikan penyebaran dan mengingatkan teman dengan santun","meneruskan tangkapan layar ke grup lain","menyimpan tangkapan layar untuk bahan candaan","menambahkan cerita agar unggahan lebih menarik"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Bendahara kelas menerima iuran Rp500.000. Setelah membeli perlengkapan kegiatan sebesar Rp425.000, terdapat sisa Rp75.000. Seorang teman menyarankan sisa uang dipakai jajan tanpa meminta persetujuan kelas.
Tindakan yang mencerminkan amanah adalah …
examQuestion.options: ["menggunakan sisa uang karena jumlahnya tidak besar","menyimpan sisa uang tanpa memberi tahu siapa pun","mencatat transaksi, melaporkan sisa dana, dan meminta keputusan kelas","membagi sisa uang hanya kepada pengurus","menghapus catatan agar tidak merepotkan"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Seorang siswa baru belum memiliki beberapa perlengkapan praktik. Teman-temannya mengumpulkan perlengkapan bekas yang masih layak. Ada usulan merekam penerima bantuan tanpa meminta izin.
Sikap yang paling tepat adalah …
examQuestion.options: ["membatalkan bantuan karena kebaikan harus dirahasiakan","memberi bantuan sambil mengekspos penerima agar konten viral","meminta penerima membalas bantuan dengan mengerjakan tugas","membantu sesuai kebutuhan dan menjaga martabat serta privasi penerima","hanya membantu jika mendapat pujian"]

examQuestion.questionText:

examQuestion.options: ["Orientation, because it introduces a new character, the noblewoman","Complication, because it shows the rising crisis and problem experienced by the characters","Resolution, because Malin Kundang successfully hides his past from his wife","Coda, because it shows the behavioral change of Malin Kundang after becoming rich","Re-orientation, because it summarizes the journey of Malin Kundang as a merchant"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Complete the following sentence from a narrative story with the correct verb forms:
"The brave knight _____ the steep mountain, _____ the magic sword from the cave, and _____ it back to the kingdom."
A. climbs – takes – brings
B. climbed – took – brought
C. climb – take – bring
D. was climbing – taken – bringed
E. climbed – taked – brought
examQuestion.options: ["climbs – takes – brings","climbed – took – brought","climb – take – bring","was climbing – taken – bringed","climbed – taked – brought"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Read the two concluding parts of a story:
Part 1: "Heartbroken, his mother prayed to God. Suddenly, a fierce storm hit Malin's ship, and as the waves crashed, Malin Kundang slowly turned into a stone."
Part 2: "From this tragedy, Malin's arrogance brought his own downfall. The story teaches us never to disrespect or forget our parents regardless of how successful we become."

Based on the theory of Narrative Text structure, what is the correct classification of Part 1 and Part 2?
A. Part 1 is Complication; Part 2 is Resolution
B. Part 1 is Resolution; Part 2 is Coda
C. Part 1 is Coda; Part 2 is Resolution
D. Part 1 is Climax; Part 2 is Orientation
E. Both Part 1 and Part 2 belong to the Complication section
examQuestion.options: ["Part 1 is Complication; Part 2 is Resolution","Part 1 is Resolution; Part 2 is Coda","Part 1 is Coda; Part 2 is Resolution","Part 1 is Climax; Part 2 is Orientation","Both Part 1 and Part 2 belong to the Complication section"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Read the sentence:
"The wicked witch gave the princess two shiny red apples poisoned with a sleeping spell."

In the sentence above, the phrases 'the wicked witch' and 'two shiny red apples' exemplify one of the language features of Narrative Text, namely ....
A. adverbs of time to sequence the events chronologically
B. action verbs in the simple past tense form
C. adjectives that modify nouns to form descriptive noun phrases
D. imperative sentences used to give direct instructions
E. temporal conjunctions that connect two independent clauses
examQuestion.options: ["adverbs of time to sequence the events chronologically","action verbs in the simple past tense form","adjectives that modify nouns to form descriptive noun phrases","imperative sentences used to give direct instructions","temporal conjunctions that connect two independent clauses"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Choose the most accurate noun phrase to describe a pet in a Descriptive Text:
A. a Persian cute small white kitten
B. a cute small white Persian kitten
C. a white small cute Persian kitten
D. a small Persian white cute kitten
E. a cute Persian white small kitten
examQuestion.options: ["a Persian cute small white kitten","a cute small white Persian kitten","a white small cute Persian kitten","a small Persian white cute kitten","a cute Persian white small kitten"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Read the sentence:
"Deep in the dark forest, the lost prince wandered alone until he finally found a hidden cottage and lived happily ever after."

Which phrases in the sentence function as adverbial phrases indicating place and manner/state?
A. the lost prince; a hidden cottage
B. wandered alone; finally found
C. deep in the dark forest; happily ever after
D. until he; and lived
E. dark forest; hidden cottage
examQuestion.options: ["the lost prince; a hidden cottage","wandered alone; finally found","Deep in the dark forest; happily ever after","until he; and lived","dark forest; hidden cottage"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Why does Narrative Text frequently use specific nouns such as 'the king', 'the queen', 'the stepmother', or 'the magic mirror' instead of general plural nouns?
A. To give general scientific facts about monarchy and objects
B. To refer to particular characters, animals, or specific objects involved in the story
C. To instruct readers on how to make royal accessories
D. To compare different types of rulers in the modern world
E. To avoid using pronouns and adjectives in the Orientation
examQuestion.options: ["To give general scientific facts about monarchy and objects","To give general scientific facts about monarchy and objects","To instruct readers on how to make royal accessories","To compare different types of rulers in the modern world","To avoid using pronouns and adjectives in the Orientation"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Read the text:
"Once upon a time, a greedy farmer had a goose that laid one golden egg every day. Not satisfied with one egg a day, the farmer thought the goose must have a huge lump of gold inside its body. He killed the goose and cut it open, only to find nothing inside. He regretted his foolishness for the rest of his life."

What caused the main complication in the story, and what lesson is implied in the ending?
A. The goose stopped laying golden eggs; we must take good care of farm animals
B. The farmer's greed to get all the gold at once; excessive greed can make us lose what we already have
C. The farmer needed money to buy a bigger farm; working hard brings great wealth
D. The goose was sick and died; patience is needed when raising animals
E. A thief tried to steal the golden eggs; we should guard our treasures carefully
examQuestion.options: ["The goose stopped laying golden eggs; we must take good care of farm animals","The farmer's greed to get all the gold at once; excessive greed can make us lose what we already have","The farmer needed money to buy a bigger farm; working hard brings great wealth","The goose was sick and died; patience is needed when raising animals","A thief tried to steal the golden eggs; we should guard our treasures carefully"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Arrange the following sentences into a coherent Narrative Text:
1. Finally, the clever mouse deer tricked the crocodiles into lining up across the river so he could count them and cross safely.
2. One hot afternoon, a clever mouse deer wanted to cross a wide river to reach a field of fresh cucumbers.
3. From that day on, the crocodiles realized that brains could easily defeat strength.
4. However, the river was full of hungry crocodiles waiting to eat him if he swam across.

The correct arrangement based on the generic structure (Orientation – Complication – Resolution – Coda) is ....
A. 2 – 1 – 4 – 3
B. 2 – 4 – 1 – 3
C. 4 – 2 – 1 – 3
D. 2 – 4 – 3 – 1
E. 1 – 2 – 4 – 3

In complex Narrative Texts such as novels or long folktales, how does the 'Resolution' section commonly function when a major complication occurs?
A. There can only be strictly one sentence of resolution at the very end
B. There is often more than one resolution to solve the complication, sometimes leading to new minor conflicts before the final ending
C. The resolution always happens before the orientation is introduced
D. The resolution only explains the physical traits of the antagonist
E. The resolution is completely optional and rarely found in narrative stories
examQuestion.options: ["There can only be strictly one sentence of resolution at the very end","There is often more than one resolution to solve the complication, sometimes leading to new minor conflicts before the final ending","The resolution always happens before the orientation is introduced","The resolution only explains the physical traits of the antagonist","The resolution is completely optional and rarely found in narrative stories"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Read the short narrative paragraph:
"Yesterday, Cinderella goes to the royal ball in a beautiful carriage. She danced with the prince until midnight. When the clock struck twelve, she runs out of the palace and left her glass slipper."

Which correction makes the text consistent with the language features of Narrative Text?
A. Change 'danced' to 'dances' and 'left' to 'leaves'
B. Change 'goes' to 'went' and 'runs' to 'ran'
C. Change 'struck' to 'strikes' and 'left' to 'leave'
D. Change 'Yesterday' to 'Every day' and 'danced' to 'dance'
E. Change 'beautiful' to 'beautifully' and 'glass' to 'glasses'
examQuestion.options: ["Change 'danced' to 'dances' and 'left' to 'leaves'","Change 'goes' to 'went' and 'runs' to 'ran'","Change 'struck' to 'strikes' and 'left' to 'leave'","Change 'Yesterday' to 'Every day' and 'danced' to 'dance'","Change 'beautiful' to 'beautifully' and 'glass' to 'glasses'"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Descriptive Text aims to describe a particular object specifically and factually so that readers can visualize it clearly. Which of the following topics is the MOST appropriate for a Descriptive Text rather than a Report Text?
A. Rhinoceroses in general as an endangered mammal species
B. My favorite black leather shoes that I bought last month
C. How smartphones are manufactured in modern factories
D. The general classification of volcanic mountains in Indonesia
E. The lifecycle of butterflies from egg to adult
examQuestion.options: ["Rhinoceroses in general as an endangered mammal species","My favorite black leather shoes that I bought last month","How smartphones are manufactured in modern factories","The general classification of volcanic mountains in Indonesia","The lifecycle of butterflies from egg to adult"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Consider the following five writing topics:
1. Maudy Ayunda's physical appearance and humble personality
2. The lively atmosphere of the Sekaten traditional festival
3. Komodo Island and its pink sandy beach
4. How a traditional batik cloth is dyed and waxed
5. My cute Persian kitten named Milo
16. Which topic represents 'Describing an Event'?
A. Topic 1
B. Topic 2
C. Topic 3
D. Topic 4
E. Topic 5
examQuestion.options: ["Topic 1","Topic 2","Topic 3","Topic 4","Topic 5"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Jumat ini seorang khatib menyampaikan khutbah pertama, kemudian duduk sejenak, lalu berdiri kembali untuk khutbah kedua sebelum iqamah salat Jumat.
Jeda duduk di antara dua khutbah menunjukkan …
examQuestion.options: ["khatib telah menyelesaikan salat Jumat","khutbah kedua tidak diperlukan","pemisah antara dua khutbah sebagaimana tata cara yang diajarkan","jamaah boleh meninggalkan masjid","imam harus mengganti khatib"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Rumusan Butir Soal:
Read the text:
"My favorite English teacher, Miss Clara, is a tall woman with long wavy hair, bright brown eyes, and a pointed nose. Beyond her neat appearance, she is very humble, patient, and honest. She always greets her students with a warm smile and listens carefully to their opinions."

Which words from the text describe Miss Clara's emotional and personality traits rather than her physical traits?
A. tall, long wavy hair, bright brown eyes
B. pointed nose, neat appearance, tall
C. humble, patient, honest
D. wavy hair, warm smile, pointed nose
E. English teacher, tall woman, brown eyes
examQuestion.options: ["tall, long wavy hair, bright brown eyes","pointed nose, neat appearance, tall","humble, patient, honest","wavy hair, warm smile, pointed nose","English teacher, tall woman, brown eyes"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Read the text:
"Fatahillah Museum is located in the heart of Jakarta's Old Town (Kota Tua). The grand white Dutch colonial building features tall wooden windows, a spacious cobblestone courtyard in front, and historical artifacts displayed neatly inside its rooms. Visitors often take photos in front of its classic facade."

Based on the text, how does the writer help the readers visualize Fatahillah Museum?
A. By explaining the step-by-step ticket purchasing procedure
B. By telling a fictional ghost story that happened in the courtyard
C. By presenting concrete details about its location, color, architectural style, and surroundings
D. By arguing why the government should renovate all old buildings
E. By comparing Fatahillah Museum with the Taj Mahal in India
examQuestion.options: ["By explaining the step-by-step ticket purchasing procedure","By telling a fictional ghost story that happened in the courtyard","By presenting concrete details about its location, color, architectural style, and surroundings","By arguing why the government should renovate all old buildings","By comparing Fatahillah Museum with the Taj Mahal in India"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Read the text:
"The Javan rhinoceros is a rare large mammal with thick, greyish-brown skin that folds like armor plates. Unlike the African rhino, it has only a single short horn on its snout, which it uses to dig up roots and break branches while foraging in dense rainforests."

What specific information is provided in the description of the Javan rhinoceros?
A. Its skin color and texture, unique body part, and the function of its horn
B. The exact population number of Javan rhinos in every zoo worldwide
C. A step-by-step guide on how to feed a rhinoceros in captivity
D. A narrative story about a hunter who saved a baby rhino
E. The emotional personality of the rhinoceros toward tourists
examQuestion.options: ["Its skin color and texture, unique body part, and the function of its horn","The exact population number of Javan rhinos in every zoo worldwide","A step-by-step guide on how to feed a rhinoceros in captivity","A narrative story about a hunter who saved a baby rhino","The emotional personality of the rhinoceros toward tourists"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Read the text:
"During the Lantern Festival last night, the entire city square glowed with thousands of red and gold lanterns hanging above the crowd. The air was filled with the joyful sound of traditional drums and the sweet aroma of roasted chestnuts from street stalls."

Why is this paragraph classified as 'Describing an Event'?
A. It gives instructions on how to make red and gold lanterns at home
B. It captures the sensory details—sight, sound, and smell—of the festival's atmosphere so readers feel present
C. It introduces the biography of the festival organizer
D. It explains the chemical process behind burning lanterns
E. It presents a conflict between street vendors and visitors
examQuestion.options: ["It gives instructions on how to make red and gold lanterns at home","It captures the sensory details—sight, sound, and smell—of the festival's atmosphere so readers feel present","It introduces the biography of the festival organizer","It introduces the biography of the festival organizer","It presents a conflict between street vendors and visitors"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Students often confuse 'Describing a Process' (a type of Descriptive Text) with 'Procedure Text'. What is the key difference between the two?
A. Describing a Process explains how something works/is completed, why it is done, and what is needed in descriptive paragraphs, whereas Procedure Text gives direct step-by-step imperative commands for the reader to follow
B. Describing a Process always uses Past Tense, whereas Procedure Text uses Future Tense
C. Describing a Process is only for cooking recipes, whereas Procedure Text is only for tourist places
D. Describing a Process uses bullet points with imperative verbs, whereas Procedure Text never uses sequence words
E. There is no difference at all; both have the exact same communicative purpose and structure
examQuestion.options: ["Describing a Process explains how something works/is completed, why it is done, and what is needed in descriptive paragraphs, whereas Procedure Text gives direct step-by-step imperative commands for the reader to follow","Describing a Process always uses Past Tense, whereas Procedure Text uses Future Tense","Describing a Process is only for cooking recipes, whereas Procedure Text is only for tourist places","Describing a Process uses bullet points with imperative verbs, whereas Procedure Text never uses sequence words","There is no difference at all; both have the exact same communicative purpose and structure"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Read the text:
"My smartphone _____ a sleek rectangular body with a 6.5-inch AMOLED screen. Its back cover is matte blue, which _____ smooth and does not easily show fingerprints."

Which pair of words best completes the descriptive text above?
A. had – felt
B. has – feels
C. have – feel
D. is having – feeling
E. will have – will feel
examQuestion.options: ["had – felt","has – feels","have – feel","is having – feeling","will have – will feel"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Read the text:
"Namsan Seoul Tower is an iconic observation tower located on Namsan Mountain in central Seoul. At night, the tower is illuminated with colorful LED lights that indicate the city's air quality. At the base of the tower, thousands of 'Locks of Love' are attached to the fences by couples."

According to the text, what is the special function of the colorful LED lights on Namsan Seoul Tower at night?
A. To guide airplanes landing at the nearest airport
B. To show the current air quality condition in Seoul
C. To celebrate national holidays every single night
D. To illuminate the locks attached by visitors
E. To signal the closing time of the observation deck
examQuestion.options: ["To guide airplanes landing at the nearest airport","To show the current air quality condition in Seoul","To celebrate national holidays every single night","To illuminate the locks attached by visitors","To signal the closing time of the observation deck"]

examQuestion.questionText: Pancasila sebagai pandangan hidup bangsa berfungsi sebagai...
examQuestion.options: ["Aturan yang harus dipatuhi dengan ancaman hukuman","Petunjuk arah bagaimana manusia Indonesia seharusnya bersikap dan bertindak","Cerita sejarah masa lalu saja","Simbol kebanggaan tanpa makna","Materi ujian semata"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Read the paragraph:
"(1) My favorite shoes are a pair of classic white canvas sneakers. (2) They have durable rubber soles and clean white shoelaces. (3) First, untie the laces and put them into warm soapy water for ten minutes. (4) Although I have worn them for a year, they are still very comfortable for walking."

Which sentence does NOT fit the characteristics of a Descriptive Text because it shifts into a Procedure Text?
A. Sentence (1)
B. Sentence (2)
C. Sentence (3)
D. Sentence (4)
E. All sentences fit Descriptive Text
examQuestion.options: ["Sentence (1)","Sentence (2)","Sentence (3)","Sentence (4)","All sentences fit Descriptive Text"]

examQuestion.questionText:
What is the main purpose of a Procedure Text, and which group of texts represents common examples of it?
A. To entertain readers; fairy tales, legends, and fables
B. To inform readers about a sequence of steps so the expected result is achieved; cookbooks, user manuals, and directions
C. To describe specific places; travel brochures and personal diaries
D. To retell past experiences; biographies and historical recounts
E. To report current events; newspaper articles and weather forecasts
examQuestion.options: ["To entertain readers; fairy tales, legends, and fables","To inform readers about a sequence of steps so the expected result is achieved; cookbooks, user manuals, and directions","To describe specific places; travel brochures and personal diaries","To retell past experiences; biographies and historical recounts","To report current events; newspaper articles and weather forecasts"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Read the text:
"Composting is a natural recycling process that turns organic kitchen waste into nutrient-rich fertilizer for plants. To complete this process effectively, a balanced mixture of 'green' materials like vegetable scraps, 'brown' materials like dry leaves, water, and proper air circulation are required so microorganisms can decompose the waste without bad odors."

Based on the text, why is composting carried out?
A. To eliminate all microorganisms in the soil
B. To convert organic kitchen waste into nutrient-rich plant fertilizer
C. To produce bad odors from dry leaves and water
D. To replace air circulation in indoor gardens
E. To separate plastic waste from vegetable scraps
examQuestion.options: ["To eliminate all microorganisms in the soil","To convert organic kitchen waste into nutrient-rich plant fertilizer","To produce bad odors from dry leaves and water","To replace air circulation in indoor gardens","To separate plastic waste from vegetable scraps"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Read the steps of 'How to Make Meatballs':
1. _____, grind the spices.
2. Second, mix the ground spices with eggs, tapioca flour, and minced meat.
3. _____, add a glass of water and knead the dough until smooth.
4. After that, boil water in a large pot.
5. Then, shape the dough into small balls.
6. _____, put the meatballs into the boiling water until they float.

Which sequence of temporal conjunctions correctly completes steps 1, 3, and 6?
A. Finally – First – Next
B. First – Next – Finally
C. Next – Finally – First
D. First – Finally – Next
E. After that – First – Lastly
examQuestion.options: ["Finally – First – Next","First – Next – Finally","Next – Finally – First","First – Finally – Next","After that – First – Lastly"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Read the instruction:
"I would start by downloading the application from the store. _____, open the app and register using your active email address."

Which phrase best fills in the blank to continue the instruction?
A. The last thing you do is
B. Once you've done that, then
C. Before you begin,
D. In the end,
E. The best place to begin is
examQuestion.options: ["The last thing you do is","Once you've done that, then","Before you begin,","In the end,","The best place to begin is"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Read the excerpt from 'How to Make Meatballs':
"Boil at least 2 liters of water in a large pot. Shape the dough into small balls. Finally, put the meatballs into the boiling water. When the meatballs float to the surface, they are ready to be served."

According to the text, how do we know that the meatballs are cooked and ready to serve?
A. When the water in the pot completely evaporates
B. When the dough feels soft and smooth in our fingers
C. When the meatballs rise and float to the surface of the boiling water
D. After boiling them for exactly two liters of water
E. As soon as the spices are mixed with tapioca flour
examQuestion.options: ["When the water in the pot completely evaporates","When the dough feels soft and smooth in our fingers","When the meatballs rise and float to the surface of the boiling water","After boiling them for exactly two liters of water","As soon as the spices are mixed with tapioca flour"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Situation: A new intern at an office does not know how to operate the photocopier. The office manager wants to give polite instructions.

How should the manager phrase the instruction politely?
A. Press the green button now!
B. Don't touch anything else, just put the paper here!
C. First, you can place the document face down on the glass, and please press the start button.
D. Be quiet and watch me do it!
E. How do I use this photocopier?
examQuestion.options: ["Press the green button now!","Don't touch anything else, just put the paper here!","First, you can place the document face down on the glass, and please press the start button.","Be quiet and watch me do it!","How do I use this photocopier?"]

examQuestion.questionText:
When explaining a process from the very beginning, which group of phrases belongs to the 'Starting Out' stage?
A. After that... / Once you've done that, then...
B. In the end, / When you've completed all steps,
C. Before you begin, (you should...) / The best place to begin is...
D. The next thing you do is... / When you finish that, then...
E. The last step is... / When you've finished,
examQuestion.options: ["After that... / Once you've done that, then...","In the end, / When you've completed all steps,","Before you begin, (you should...) / The best place to begin is...","The next thing you do is... / When you finish that, then...","The last step is... / When you've finished,"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Situation: You and your close friend are already late for the school bus, and your friend is still tying his shoelaces slowly.

Which informal/direct instruction is the most natural and appropriate to say in this situation?
A. Could you possibly consider accelerating your pace so we do not miss the bus?
B. Hurry up and let's go now!
C. May I suggest that we depart immediately?
D. What is the best way to catch the school bus?
E. Would you be so kind as to tie your shoes faster, Sir?
examQuestion.options: ["Could you possibly consider accelerating your pace so we do not miss the bus?","Hurry up and let's go now!","Hurry up and let's go now!","What is the best way to catch the school bus?","Would you be so kind as to tie your shoes faster, Sir?"]

examQuestion.questionText: Tujuan utama seseorang menjalankan usaha adalah...
examQuestion.options: ["Mendapatkan keuntungan","Menghabiskan uang","Mengurangi pelanggan","Menghindari pekerjaan","Menambah pengeluaran"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Complete the dialogue:
Rina: "I have never used this digital microscope before. _____"
Lab Assistant: "The first thing you do is plug in the power cable and turn on the LED switch."

Which expression best completes Rina's turn?
A. The best place to begin is turning on the switch.
B. Can you show me how to operate it?
C. Once you've done that, adjust the lens.
D. Please listen to what I'm saying!
E. When you've finished, turn off the light.
examQuestion.options: ["The best place to begin is turning on the switch.","Can you show me how to operate it?","Once you've done that, adjust the lens.","Please listen to what I'm saying!","When you've finished, turn off the light."]

examQuestion.questionText:
Read the closing instruction of a laboratory procedure:
"_____, ensure all gas valves are tightly closed and wash your hands thoroughly before leaving the room."

Which phrase is most appropriate to complete this final step?
A. To begin with,
B. The first thing you do is
C. When you've completed all steps,
D. I would start by
E. What is the first step?
examQuestion.options: ["To begin with,","The first thing you do is","When you've completed all steps,","I would start by","What is the first step?"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Read the instruction in a user manual:
"When the red indicator light _____, it _____ that the battery is fully charged."

Which verb forms correctly complete the sentence according to the language features of Procedure Text?
A. stopped blinking – meant
B. stops blinking – means
C. stop blinking – mean
D. will stop blinking – meant
E. was stopping – was meaning
examQuestion.options: ["stopped blinking – meant","stops blinking – means","stop blinking – mean","will stop blinking – meant","was stopping – was meaning"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Read the dialogue:
Andi: "How do I go about making a cup of instant coffee?"
Budi: "The first thing you do is boil some water. After that, pour the hot water into a mug. Next, stir it well. Finally, put the coffee powder and sugar into the mug."

What is the logical flaw in Budi's instructions?
A. Budi used formal expressions instead of informal ones
B. Budi instructed Andi to stir the water before putting the coffee powder and sugar into the mug
C. Budi forgot to mention how to grow coffee beans
D. Budi used Past Tense verbs instead of imperative verbs
E. Andi did not ask a question about making coffee
examQuestion.options: ["Budi used formal expressions instead of informal ones","Budi instructed Andi to stir the water before putting the coffee powder and sugar into the mug","Budi forgot to mention how to grow coffee beans","Budi used Past Tense verbs instead of imperative verbs","Andi did not ask a question about making coffee"]

examQuestion.questionText:
Read the three short text excerpts:
Text X: "First, peel two ripe bananas and mash them in a bowl. Next, add one egg and mix well."
Text Y: "Long ago, in a quiet village, lived a kind woodcutter who found a golden axe in the river."

Which classification accurately identifies Text X, Text Y, and Text Z?

B. Text X = Procedure; Text Y = Narrative; Text Z = Descriptive
